field.name: projectCostPostingEnabled
field.description: Post approved project time at its cost rate to project cost, from the labor clearing account (OtherAutoPostServices.post#WorkEffortCost, on timesheet approval). Off by default.

field.name: forwardReceiptRepostEnabled
field.description: Y: repost#AssetReceipt posts a dated delta (ReceiptAdjustments.js) and leaves the posted history, as forwardIssuanceRepostEnabled does for issuances (impl-manufacturing F32)

field.name: writeOffToleranceAmount
field.description: The largest amount, in the base currency, a user without INVOICE_APPROVE writes off on a settlement or credits against an issued invoice without an approver (SEC-BOS-127); empty or 0: every write-off and linked customer credit needs an approver

field.name: rateProviderServiceName
field.description: The exchange rate provider refresh#Rates calls: the enumCode (a service implementing CurrencyServices.define#RateProvider) of an ExchangeRateProvider enumeration; none, no fetch.

field.name: receiptInvoiceSelfBilledOnly
field.description: Y: a delivered incoming shipment bills itself only for a self-billing supplier (SupplierProfile), and then for the accepted quantity only, with no leftover or charge lines; other bills come from the supplier (import#Bill) or from the order (create#InvoiceFromSource). N, the default: every delivered incoming shipment is billed as before.

field.name: invoicePayGatewayConfigId
field.description: The gateway a customer pays an invoice through on the organization's Billing pages; one of its PaymentGatewayOrganization bindings. Empty, the pages offer no payment.

field.name: orderConfirmationOnPlace
field.description: Y: store each placed sales order's confirmation PDF as OrderContent (OctOrderConfirmation) after the placement commits, in a transaction of its own; a failure is logged and never fails the placement. N (the default): the first store or resend renders it as of the placed time.

field.name: returnSettlementRequired
field.description: Y: approving a return only creates its shipment, a return is received through WarehouseTaskServices.receive#ReturnItems, and credits, refunds and replacements come only from ReturnServices.settle#Return, for the quantity received. N, the default: Mantle responds at approval (immediate responses), at receipt and when the return shipment is delivered, as before.

field.name: salesInvoiceFinalizedAtShip
field.description: Y: the sales invoice made when an outgoing shipment is packed stays in process, with no payment applied, until the shipment ships, when it is finalized, applied the order's captured payments and sent; until then InvoiceServices.release#ShipmentDraftInvoice takes a reopened package's lines off it. N, the default: the invoice is finalized and paid at pack, as before.

field.name: kitCostFromComponents
field.description: Y: a pick-assembly kit made at pack (produce#AvailableAssemblies, for every caller) is received at the cost of the component issuances it uses (each issuance's quantity times its asset's acquireCost), divided by the kit quantity at the four decimals acquireCost keeps, a remainder received apart on its own unit, so the components leave work in process exactly and the kit's issue posts its cost of goods sold. N, the default: the kit is received with no cost, as before (AtrNoAcquireCost).

field.name: salesCommercialRevisionOnly
field.description: Y: a sales order this organization sells counts only commercial changes in its revision (a line's quantity or price, the part's address, carrier or method, its parties and terms), not a stored file, a note or a status-only part update (a hold, an approval), so an order-change proposal or a quote approval stays bound to the order it saw. N (the default): every change counts, as before.

field.name: scrapGlAccountId
field.description: The debit account of a count variance with a scrap reason (an InventoryVarianceReason with enumCode scrap) when the organization has no VarianceReasonGlAccount row for the reason

field.name: exchangeRate
field.description: One unit of originalCurrencyUomId in amountUomId (the base currency), as decimal text; set by post#AcctgTrans when it converts a transaction from its document's currency.

field.name: payrollOrigin
field.description: Y: a transaction of a payroll-origin invoice or payment, read with PAYROLL_VIEW alone
